scripts.setup: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run compile && bun run ui:build
scripts.test: cd .. && bun run ensure-contract-artifacts && cd trading && bun run compile && cd .. && bun run refresh:shared-dependencies && cd trading && bun run tsc && bun test ./ts/tests ./ui/ts/tests
scripts.check: bunx @biomejs/biome check package.json tsconfig.json scripts ts ui/ts ui/build ui/css docs README.md SECURITY.md AGENTS.md && bun run check:number-casts && bun run format:check && bun run test
scripts.format: bunx @biomejs/biome format --write package.json tsconfig.json scripts ts ui/ts ui/build ui/css docs README.md SECURITY.md AGENTS.md && cd .. && bunx prettier --write 'trading/contracts/**/*.sol'
scripts.format:check: bunx @biomejs/biome format package.json tsconfig.json scripts ts ui/ts ui/build ui/css docs README.md SECURITY.md AGENTS.md && cd .. && bunx prettier --check 'trading/contracts/**/*.sol'
scripts.gas-costs: bun run compile && TRADING_REPORT_GAS=1 bun test ./ts/tests/pairRouter.integration.test.ts && bun ./ts/tests/gas-costs.mts
